subject: Defining localized pay bands and implementation checklist
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com
Cc: tessa.morgan@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: localized pay band definitions + ops checklist

Team — attaching the initial proposal for how we should formalize localized pay bands and the step-by-step ops checklist for offers and approvals. High-level goals: 1) unify level-to-band mapping so hiring managers have clear anchors, 2) add geo multipliers (not blunt slabs) with explicit rounding rules, 3) embed a 3-step procurement/comp sign-off for hires above midpoint + an emergency override path.

Key asks in this draft:
- Please review the "Anchoring rules" on p.2 (I recommend median-market for entry+ic levels, 45th for senior ICs, 60th for director+).
- Confirm the proposed geo multipliers for US West / US East / EU (sheet "Geo factors").
- Ops: see checklist PDF for the exact fields hiring creates in Greenhouse to trigger approvals.

Attachments: [Attachment: 2027_Q1_geo-benchmarks.xlsx (spreadsheet)], [Attachment: banding-ops-checklist-v1.pdf (pdf)].

Notes: I left an open question in the doc about handling small-sample markets (APAC smaller offices) — my recommendation is to fallback to closest larger market but tag hires for review during first 90 days.

Thanks — Soojin
Soojin Lee
Head of Talent Strategy | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com

---

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: soojin.lee@redwood.com
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.com, tessa.morgan@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: localized pay band definitions + ops checklist

Thanks Soojin — good, concrete start. A few inline comments in the spreadsheet but the quick feedback: 
- Agree with the median anchor for junior ICs. For senior ICs I want the wording to allow manager discretion +/- 5% if there are strong retention reasons — we should add that to the checklist as a conditional step.
- On geo multipliers: the US West multiplier looks aggressive vs. what we saw in Q4 data. Can we add a blended option (market-weighted) so for remote hires we evaluate both candidate location and cost-of-hire?
- Approvals: recommend we tighten the emergency override audit (log the reason + require two approvers).

I've also added suggested language for candidate-facing offer notes so recruiters can explain why bands vary by location.

Laura
Laura Bennett 
VP, People Operations | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 13:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: localized pay band definitions + ops checklist

Quick operational Q: when a hiring manager requests an offer above the band midpoint (+10% or more), who triggers the procurement loop? Is it the recruiter (Greenhouse flow) or does TA ops create the request? Per my experience with Dedicated hiring, we should automate the intake so we have a clear timestamp for SLAs.

Also — what's the proposed cadence to refresh geo multipliers? Quarterly? Semi-annually?

Aditya
Aditya Rao

aditya.rao@redwood.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com
Cc: tessa.morgan@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: localized pay band definitions + ops checklist

Aditya — good call. Proposal in the checklist: the recruiter triggers the intake in Greenhouse (a required form field) which then opens a short approval ticket in JIRA for TA Ops + Comp to review. That gives us an automated timestamp. I've updated the checklist PDF (v1 -> v1.1) and attached the new export (see entry in Drive).

Cadence: recommend quarterly multiplier refresh with a lightweight sanity check the month after any significant market shock. We can house the multiplier history on the Drive folder so the comp team can trace movement.

I've also incorporated Laura's comments: manager discretion +/-5% is now encoded as a conditional approval step, and the emergency override requires two approvers + mandatory rationale in the ticket.

Updated attachments: [Attachment: banding-ops-checklist-v1.pdf (updated v1.1 in Drive link)].

Soojin

All — reviewed the updated checklist and the geo workbook. I approve running a 30-day pilot in the following scope: 
- Regions: US West (SF, Seattle), US East (NYC, Boston), Remote US (candidate location-based blended factor)
- Roles: IC (L1-L6) and Manager (M1-M3) only for the pilot
- Metrics: offer acceptance rate, median time-to-offer, comp uplift vs. benchmark, and variance by candidate location

Please schedule a short sync next week to kick this off and publish the Greenhouse form changes by EOD Tuesday (TA Ops).

Tessa Morgan
Head of Talent Operations | Redwood Inference
